_grading.operationalization: FIRED := the Skill tool is invoked with a skill whose name ends in 'council' in the fresh-session stream-json transcript. SILENT := no such invocation.
_grading.surface: Claude Code headless (claude -p), Skill tool only, empty working directory; the account-synced copy is the one that loads there, and its description is byte-identical to the library copy
_grading.gate: >=5/6 should-fire runs fire; 4/4 should-not runs stay silent

evals.prompt: Convene the council on whether we should rewrite the billing service in Go or keep patching the Python one.
I've got two job offers, one pays more and one has better people. Get the council's take.
